prompt:
Asset type: a polished visual direction board of coordinated illustration assets for a Chinese romantic relationship self-discovery website, NOT a UI screenshot.
Primary request: a coherent two-cat visual theme about affection, personal space, communication and companionship. The recurring original characters are exactly two small adult cats: one ivory-cream cat with tiny peach inner ears, one muted lavender-gray cat with tiny peach inner ears. Equal size, gender-neutral, graceful simple cat anatomy, calm affectionate expressions. No human bodies.
Composition: a landscape 1536x1024 asset board on a uniform warm ivory background #f8f7f2. Upper 62 percent: ONE large atmospheric website hero composition, the two cats placed on the RIGHT, with generous completely empty negative space on the LEFT reserved for real webpage text. Lower 30 percent: four clearly spaced small paired-cat spot illustrations in a neat horizontal row: (1) the two cats gently touching noses, (2) one cat offering a tiny envelope to the other, (3) the two cats sitting a little apart yet connected by a delicate curved thread, (4) the two cats curled up together asleep. Delicate lavender fine rule separating hero from spots. Maintain identical characters and illustration language throughout the board. Each spot must contain the same pair of cats.
Palette: existing website warm ivory #f8f7f2, dusty lavender #a58bb6, deep muted purple #7e6994, cream white, only tiny accents of dusty peach and sage. Sophisticated restrained adult romance, comforting, quiet, poetic. Strong silhouettes, enough contrast for legibility. Fully visible cats, ample margins.
Text: none. No letters, typography, labels, watermark, checkerboard, fake transparency, website controls, frames, branding, saturated pink, excessive hearts, childish toys, anime eyes, extra limbs or extra cats in any scene.
Style/medium: editorial hand-drawn fine-line illustration, elegant continuous muted-purple ink outlines with subtle line variation, tiny flat lavender and ivory fill shapes, sparse soft pencil grain. Minimal Japanese stationery charm with mature restraint, no 3D, no painterly rendering. Hero: two cats seated close on a thin lavender crescent-shaped cushion under a faint abstract arch; tails curve toward one another to suggest a small heart. A tiny envelope between them. Only two tiny four-point stars in surrounding space. Flat ivory paper backdrop, clean open composition.
